system: fossil threespine stickleback dorsal-spine trait series
citation: Hunt G, Bell MA, Travis MP. 2008. Evolution toward a new adaptive optimum: phenotypic evolution in a fossil stickleback lineage. Evolution 62:700-710.

preprocessing: replace one zero within-sample variance with pooled variance
convert Kyr to generations at 500 generations/Kyr
fit Joint fixed OU with no additional variance pooling
paper_matched_refit.classification: reproduced within 1 percent in reported half-life using pinned current source and paper-matched preprocessing

semantic_boundary: The fitted approximately 845-853 generation relaxation half-life remains a model-conditional observed timescale. The exact congruent reciprocal witness shows that the whole fitted alpha is not uniquely attributable to a one-way direct attraction/selection coefficient from the trait likelihood alone.
version_caveat: The refit uses paleoTS 0.6.2 source from 2024, not the authors' original 2008 software environment; the small residual numerical difference is not interpreted as an error.
